headline: AQUA plunges 10% at open and posts an 11.11% intraday rally amid dual CFO resignations.
market_take: Prop sector stocks led the downside with several >10% drops and notable volume spikes, while agribusiness showed strength, highlighted by STA and PPPM gains above 7%. Unusual‑trading alerts were dominated by price gaps and volume spikes, and several high‑impact filings—AQUA CFO resignations, TPOLY rehab petition, and NVD share repurchase—add to market caution.

sector_notes.note: AQUA recorded a -10.00% opening gap and a +11.11% intraday move, coinciding with CFO resignations; TWPC opened down -5.93%.
PF, EVER, WIN, RICHY and others fell 6‑14% with volume spikes for CPN (6.0σ), LALIN (4.3σ) and PRIN (5.7σ); CPN’s spike stands out.
TPOLY posted a -10.00% intraday decline and filed a high‑priority business rehabilitation petition; SOLAR rose +9.52% intraday and TEKA saw a 3.7σ volume spike.
STA and PPPM surged +8.02% and +7.41% intraday respectively; TRUBB added +5.77% with a 3.49× volume spike; TEGH logged a 3.0σ volume spike.
HPF experienced a 3.8σ volume spike; TU-PF and HYDROGEN each opened with a -100.00% gap, suggesting possible delisting; MIPF showed a -10.31% gap but rebounded +8.62% intraday.
